_doc: Operator-ratified truncation-survival declaration for per-turn agent-contract surfaces (GHI #580 witness half, ratified 2026-07-25; landed under GHI #712). Ordering principle is RECOVERABILITY, not importance: a section whose loss an agent can repair by reading the file it names ranks below one that exists nowhere else in the per-turn surface. Section ids are the shared vocabulary minted by gzkit.content.parse.section_id over the rendered '## ' headings. Ranks are the declaration; bytes are NOT seated here — they are a measurement, re-taken live by gz validate --instructions-files-budget on every run, because a frozen measurement in a declaration is a derived view masquerading as source-of-truth (Architectural Boundary 6). Ranks at or below must_survive_through_rank are declared must-survive; the remainder are expendable-under-pressure because they are RECOVERABLE, not because they are unimportant. Ratified as data only: applying this order to the committed surface is a Layer-1 canon change requiring Gate-5 attestation through the recompose ceremony, and is parked to pool post-1.0 (GHI #580 reorder half).
